sections.heading: History
sections.text:
During the Middle Ages, Joan of Arc possessed the ring and received visions, which she became famous for. Before her death, she left the ring in the Paris Catacombs and protected it with a series of magical traps, including the Knights of Arc's Inner Circle. In a secret base located in the Cave of the Gargoyle in Rouen, she also left a map with clues leading up to the ring.

In modern times, the ring was located by the Huntik Foundation's team. After defeating the magical traps, Lok Lambert tried to take it from its display, but experienced troubling visions of The Professor and his dad Eathon Lambert. [Crawling the Catacombs]

Zhalia Moon managed to pick up the ring by protecting her mind with the spell Headcage, and later, Sophie Casterwill neutralized the ring's power for thirty minutes using Banebound. While casting the spell, she had a vision of Zhalia punching her and a vision of Sabriel's sword being destroyed. After successfully dodging DeFoe and leaving the catacombs, the ring then came under the control of the Huntik Foundation. It was stabilized inside a Reliquary and kept in one the Foundation's safehouse in Paris inside the Cathedral of Notre Dame. Local agent Clements told the team that the Foundation would conduct analyses and find a way to break the apparent curse and learn anything about the ring's powers. [Divide and Conquer]

While the team looked for Vlad Dracul's Titans in his castle in Romania, Zhalia revealed herself to be a traitor helping Klaus and engaged a fight with Sophie, confirming the first vision that the ring gave to Sophie back in the catacombs. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

During the team's final fight against The Professor, Sabriel and her Amulet were destroyed, confirming the second vision that the ring gave to Sophie back in the catacombs. [The Mission]

Later, while being kept at Notre Dame, the ring started wrecking havoc by hypnotizing Clements and unleashing Titans. The Huntik team was sent to Paris to put the ring back under control. They had to be hypnotized as well and enter a dream world where they fought against visions of their deepest fears. Lok was the first one to escape and return to the real world, where he saw the real source of the ring's power: the Legendary Titan of Fate, Arc. Lok, thanks to Powerbonded Lindorm and Dante Vale, managed to defeat Arc and sent it back to its amulet, freeing the rest of the team and Clements. The team deemed the ring's tendency to inflict despair through its visions way too dangerous to be used, and decided to seal it for good. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]
